title: dev.qory.run.exited
description: The run ended: the runtime exited, or the run was ended without one. The result of the run and its last event. A session's run always contains state and exit_code; a run a gateway opened has no process and contains neither. The schema cannot tell the two apart, since this event does not contain opened_by: dev.qory.run.started does.

state.description: succeeded on exit status 0, failed otherwise, including a signal. Present on a session's run, absent on a run a gateway opened.

exit_code.description: The exit status, or -1 when the runtime was killed by a signal. Present on a session's run, absent on a run a gateway opened.

signal.description: The signal that killed the runtime, when one did: SIGKILL, SIGTERM.

reason.description: Why the run ended other than by the runtime's own exit, when it did. timeout: the run's time limit was reached and the session stopped the runtime. run_closed: the events endpoint answered a signed 410 run_closed, and the session stopped the runtime as at its time limit; the event is recorded in the file sink, and nothing further is sent for the run. gateway_lost: the gateway was lost before the runtime's exit was recorded, because Forager died, and the event is written after the run has ended, by whatever sends the record again; exit_code is then -1 and the state failed, since the record contains no status, and duration_ms runs to the last event recorded. session_lost: the gateway heard nothing from the session for 3 × its heartbeat interval; exit_code is -1 and the state failed, as with gateway_lost. quiet: a run with no session had no connection for the gateway's quiet period, quiet_seconds. credential_expired: the run credential's exp passed with no fresh credential for the same run key. run_ended_at_issuer: the issuer's introspection endpoint answered that the run credential is no longer active. The gateway writes session_lost, quiet, credential_expired and run_ended_at_issuer. Absent when the runtime ended by itself or was stopped from outside Forager. state says how the runtime exited, where there is one; a receiver maps each reason to a state of its own.

quiet_seconds.description: The quiet period the gateway applied, in seconds. Present when reason is quiet, absent otherwise.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds from run.started to the run's end.
